title: Composition and base change of weakly etale morphisms
statement: Let $f:U\to V$ and $g:V\to W$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. If $f$ and $g$ are weakly etale [def-weil-weakly-etale-morphism], then $g\circ f$ is weakly etale. If $f$ is weakly etale and $h:V^{\prime}\to V$ is any morphism of schemes, then the projection $V^{\prime}\times_V U\to V^{\prime}$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is weakly etale.
